office_does: The Prosecuting Attorney prosecutes crimes under state law in Cowlitz County and is the legal adviser to county government.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Ryan P. Jurvakainen (prefers Independent), in office 12 years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Cowlitz County Prosecuting Attorney for 12 years (prefers Independent), seeking another term; the only candidate.
highlights: Prosecuting Attorney for the last 12 years [S1]
Says the office aggressively holds violent and persistent offenders accountable [S1]
Supports drug court and mental health court when appropriate to reduce recidivism [S1]
